entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Everyone's comments used to be[n]so encouraging, but now they're[n]actually kinda frightening...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: The public dislike of Okumura[n]has grown exponentially as well.[n]How are you holding up, Haru?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: We've been receiving anonymous[n]threats almost every day now...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: But our security is tight, so[n]it's been OK so far.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I believe things will calm down[n]once we finish this, Haru.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: And what about us? Are we gonna[n]get all popular and shit again?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Let us not concern ourselves[n]with that for now. I only pray[n]that things calm down.
